**LayoutFixer is now on Windows too.** Typed a whole sentence on the wrong keyboard layout? Press <kbd>Tab</kbd>.

## What's new

- **Windows version.** The same app and the same Tab-to-fix popup, in the system tray.
- **Smarter detection.** A fix is only suggested when the other reading is a real word, so names, brands and typos (`github`, `figma`, `teh`) are never touched.

## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| **macOS** 13 or later (Apple silicon and Intel) | `LayoutFixer-macOS.zip` |
| **Windows** 10 or 11, most PCs | `LayoutFixer-Windows-x64.zip` |
| **Windows** on ARM (Snapdragon laptops) | `LayoutFixer-Windows-arm64.zip` |

Step-by-step install guides for both platforms are in the [README](https://github.com/sina-developer/LayoutFixer#install).
The apps aren't signed by Apple or Microsoft yet, so both show a one-time warning on first launch. The guide shows how to get past it.
